name: University of Hertfordshire
description:
The University of Hertfordshire (Herts) is one of the highest-ranking public universities based in Hatfield, England. Established in 1952 as a Technical College, the institution initially provided natural sciences, mechanical, and aeronautical engineering courses. Herts then rose through time, gaining university status in 1992. The university now offers more than 550 courses in different fields of study. The University of Hertfordshire is known for its friendly environment, hosting over 32,000 students from 140 countries and becoming one of the finest educational institutions in the United Kingdom.

The students and faculties praise the University of Hertfordshire for providing the finest facilities to enhance their campus experience. highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value:

Established in 1952 as a Technical College, the institution initially provided natural sciences, mechanical, and aeronautical engineering courses. Herts then rose through time, gaining university status in 1992. The university now offers more than 550 courses in different fields of study. The University of Hertfordshire is known for its friendly environment, hosting over 32,000 students from 140 countries and becoming one of the finest educational institutions in the United Kingdom.

The students and faculties praise the University of Hertfordshire for providing the finest facilities to enhance their campus experience. The facilities strive to give comfort, convenience and support to the students. The institution's facilities are available at the College Lane or de Havilland campuses.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
In addition to facilities, the University of Hertfordshire has excellent accommodation to suit your requirements. You will get to stay in a secure environment as Hertfordshire is ranked among the top five safest counties to live in England and Wales. Student accommodations are close to other facilities, so it is easy for you to commute to places of interest.

Living on campus

Living on campus at the University of Hertfordshire comes with several perks. The accommodation cost includes all bills, reducing the tension in paying the expenses separately. Living on campus means staying close to lecture halls and the university's facilities. The University of Hertfordshire provides 24/7 security for its students staying on campus.

Living off campus

The University of Hertfordshire allows students to live off campus, but you need to find accommodation that suits your needs. The institution has joined hands with the Hatfield Welwyn Borough Council to introduce the PAL accreditation scheme. This scheme helps students find good-quality and safe accommodations.

Get a Free Counselling Session

highlights.title: Library
highlights.value: The University of Hertfordshire Library brings together plenty of digital resources for students, like e-books, articles, journals, exam papers, reports, and articles. You can access the Online Library anytime and anywhere.

highlights.title: Cafeteria
highlights.value: At the University of Hertfordshire, you can grab a bite or drink wherever you want to. There are several on and off-campus outlets with various options. The university has set up two food courts and 11 food and beverage outlets with various dishes from different cuisines. These outlets ensure to fulfil your dietary needs, including Halal, vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options. You can also find franchise chains like Starbucks and Subway.

highlights.title: Sports
highlights.value: The Oval Gym at the College Lane campus is a workout space exclusively for the students and staff of the University of Hertfordshire. This 50-station gym includes various workout equipment for cardiovascular, strength and resistance training.
